title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Venetian Theatre, Las Vegas | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Venetian Theatre in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 22 May 2024.

It was the first show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour, and the first of six non-consecutive nights at the Venetian Theatre. Edgar Winter did not perform at this show due to Covid-19.

Man, what a great time in Vegas. I love this band. I love the audience. I just love it all peace and love.????????????. Two more shows Friday https://t.co/GhSMdgpa1a the Venetian hotel??? pic.twitter.com/T9PfZzSCdH

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) May 31, 2024

Starr previously performed at the Venetian on 24, 26, and 27 May 2023. He returned there on 17, 19, 20, 24, 26, and 27 September 2025.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
